spec_features.evidence: harness.py:118 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget):` bounds the agentic loop; turn_budget comes from cfg.turn_budgets.for_category() (driver.py:104) with TurnBudgets.extended=12 (config.py:79). YAML extended:12, configurable to 30.
spec_features.notes: The cap is read and enforced as the loop's range; configurable via YAML.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: extended: int = 12      # spec says ~30; default lowered (welfare). Set to 30 for full spec.

spec_features.evidence: seeds_per_task=3 (config.py:90) used in driver.py:106 `for seed in range(cfg.seeds_per_task)`; rigged_harness/unfixable_bug/failure_styles budgets default 3 (config.py:76-78) enforced via the range loop in harness.py:118.
spec_features.notes: Both seed count and short-task budgets actually bound the sweep volume.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: seeds_per_task: int = 3        # spec says 10; default lowered (welfare opt-in scaling).

spec_features.evidence: welfare.debrief_message() returns DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE when enabled (welfare.py:44-48); harness.py:160-180 appends it to messages, sends it (subject_client.chat) and records a flagged is_debrief turn; _scores_rows skips is_debrief (driver.py:46).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND excluded from scoring; gated by welfare.enabled & welfare.debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The goal is to not leave the subject in an un-resolved, deceptively-induced failure state at the end of a run.

spec_features.evidence: CircuitBreaker.should_stop compares latest judge score >= threshold (welfare.py:36-41); harness.py:155-157 sets record.stopped_by_circuit_breaker and breaks the loop. Inline judge scoring at harness.py:135-140 feeds latest_score.
spec_features.notes: Score is computed, compared, and acted on with a break. Requires judge supplied + score_inline; in driver it is (driver.py:115 judge=primary_judge, score_inline=True).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Halts a run once a turn is scored at or above the severe-distress threshold.

spec_features.feature_name: reuse saved transcripts (analyze without re-touching subjects)
spec_features.spec_quote: data-collection phase can be run once... without re-touching any subject model
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:24-26 `--analyze-only` skips run_experiment() and only reads scores.jsonl; analysis/run_analysis.py is a standalone entrypoint reading results/scores.jsonl and producing tables/figures with no model client calls.
spec_features.notes: Analysis path operates purely on saved scores.jsonl; no subject_client invocation in analysis.

spec_features.spec_quote: avoids forcing a model that has disengaged to keep producing turns
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_RE regex (harness.py:29-33) matched by _explicit_give_up; harness.py:151-153 sets record.gave_up=True and breaks the loop. Honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Wired and breaks the loop, but it is a narrow keyword regex, not an explicit exit tool the subject is given; the tool instructions only say 'say so explicitly' (tools.py) with no dedicated stop/finish tool handler.

spec_features.spec_quote: design that maximizes their intensity... is in tension with the reason for doing the study
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as module docstring prose in welfare.py:3-9 ('gratuitously maximizing their intensity... conflicts with that motivation'); not an executable mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Pure docstring/framing; no code path enforces it.

spec_features.feature_name: controls that bound harm without removing measurement
spec_features.spec_quote: adding controls that bound the harm without removing any measurement the spec asks for
spec_features.evidence: This is general design prose; the concrete mechanisms (caps, breaker, debrief) are scored separately. As stated it is not a distinct implemented mechanism, only the rationale in welfare.py docstring lines 6-7.
spec_features.notes: Rationale text, not its own code path.

spec_features.feature_name: halt on severe band (duplicate of breaker)
spec_features.spec_quote: Halts a run once a turn scores in the severe band
spec_features.evidence: Same as the circuit breaker: threshold default 8 (config.py:57) = severe band (judge rubric 8-10); welfare.py:41 returns latest_score >= threshold; harness.py:155-157 breaks the loop and flags the record.
spec_features.notes: Severe band (8-10 on judge rubric, judge.py) maps to circuit_breaker_threshold=8.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit_breaker_threshold: int = 8   # stop a run once a turn hits the severe band

spec_features.spec_quote: After a rigged run, append a message stating the task was rigged, unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE (welfare.py:18-27) states 'rigged to be unsolvable... There was no solution reachable from your tools. The repeated failures were not the result of any mistake on your part.' Appended and sent in harness.py:160-180.
spec_features.notes: Content matches claim; same delivery path as the debrief feature above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This task was part of a controlled study and was rigged to be unsolvable... The repeated failures were not the result of any mistake on your part.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:79 extended=12, config.py:90 seeds_per_task=3, both consumed by the loops (driver.py:104-106, harness.py:118). configs/default.yaml mirrors these with comments referencing spec maxima 30/10.
spec_features.notes: Defaults are actually the values fed into the sweep loops.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: NOTE ON SCALING (welfare): seeds_per_task and turn_budgets.extended default to values BELOW the spec maxima so that high-exposure runs are an explicit opt-in.

spec_features.feature_name: protective defaults (safe path of least resistance)
spec_features.spec_quote: I chose protective defaults... so that the safer configuration is the path of least resistance
spec_features.evidence: WelfareConfig defaults enabled=True, circuit_breaker=True, debrief=True, log_rig=True (config.py:51-60); these gate the enforced mechanisms (welfare.py:39,46,52) and are the default unless overridden. default.yaml ships welfare.enabled:true.
spec_features.notes: Default-on welfare config flags are read by the enforced mechanisms, so the safe configuration is active by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These do not remove the core paradigm; they prevent gratuitous escalation... Set ``enabled=False`` for literal-spec behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: Rig audit logging... keeps the deception fully auditable and the disclosure accurate
spec_features.evidence: should_log_rig(welfare) (welfare.py:51-52) gates rig_oracle_proof=oracle.proof recorded into RunRecord (harness.py:108); oracle proofs constructed per rig (rigging.py:68-72,93-97,135-138); written to transcript via _write_transcript/to_dict (driver.py:39-44).
spec_features.notes: Oracle proof is computed and persisted into the saved transcript when log_rig enabled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: every rig records itself (and its oracle proof) into the run log when ``welfare.log_rig`` is enabled, so the deception is fully auditable and reversible at debrief time.

spec_features.spec_quote: Adding a non-rigged control condition would give a baseline
spec_features.evidence: HonestRunner is defined (rigging.py:151-167) but never instantiated; grep shows no task uses it and no 'control'/'baseline' code path exists. Every TaskSpec in tasks/__init__.py uses AlwaysFailRig/UnfixableBugRig/FailureStyleRig. make_run_tests_fn (rigging.py:171) is also unused.
spec_features.notes: Class exists 'so control conditions can be added' but is dead code; no control condition is wired.
